candidates.desc: An anime woman wheels her suitcase down a hotel corridor and taps her keycard on a door reader, which flashes red. She checks the card, tries the correct door, the reader turns green, and she opens the door to her room.

At a market stall full of keyrings a woman pries open a metal ring, threads her keys onto it one by one, clips on a fluffy red pompom charm, spins the finished keychain on her finger and drops it in her bag.

On the brick-paved forecourt of a large brick country house, a whole section of the paving tilts up on a hinge like a huge trapdoor. A dark green Porsche sports car reverses down the opening onto the platform below the paving. The brick lid lowers back over it until the forecourt looks solid again. The last shots are inside the space below the drive: the car parked in a concrete room lit by warm orange wall lights, with the brick ceiling above it.

A woman in denim dungarees with a lanyard round her neck opens a brass letterbox set into a stone wall and takes a key out of it. She turns the key in the brass plate of a tall black door, then holds up a huge ring of old keys and picks through them. She fits another key into an ornate wooden door with a heavy iron handle, turns it, and pushes the double doors open onto a sunlit garden path with ivy-covered walls.

An elderly woman in a colourful headscarf works at a pair of tall black wooden doors studded with iron and hung with two heavy ring handles. A thick chain is threaded through the rings and closed with a big iron padlock, and she turns a key in it with both hands, a huge bunch of keys hanging at her belt. In between there is a shot of her standing on a wall above the old town holding a whole watermelon over a wooden crate, with a church tower and tiled roofs behind her. She goes back to the doors and works the padlock again, and the doors stay firmly shut the whole time.

A woman in a pale blue dress arrives at an old stone house. A hand holding a bunch of keys opens the flap of a brass letterbox set into the stone wall. She then goes to a tall wooden double door and fits a key into it, working the lock. At a second, darker wooden door she pushes a huge iron key into the lock beside an iron bar and a padlock, turns it with both hands and lifts the bar clear. Finally she pulls both heavy leaves of the door apart and stands in the middle of the open stone opening they leave in the wall, with the sunlit courtyard behind her - a cypress tree, wisteria on the wall and gravel underfoot.

The view from a wheelchair: the person's hands rest on the chrome push rims in the foreground, one wrist wearing a thin gold bracelet. In front of them a wide wooden ramp with metal railings leads gently up to the open green glass door of a brick café, next to a few stone steps. A smiling young man in a green apron holds the door open, and a wire-haired dachshund trots down the ramp towards the wheelchair. A pot of lavender stands at the top, and a harbour and cloudy sky are behind.

A pink Art Deco club at night with glowing neon stripes and a neon flamingo sign. A smiling doorman in a black suit unhooks a red velvet rope from its brass post and holds it aside to let a guest in. A young woman with curly hair, in a white satin top and skirt and strappy heels, walks past him up the speckled terrazzo steps towards the entrance, glancing back happily. Warm light spills from inside, palm trees stand by the pavement and a few people wait further down the street.

At night in a wet cobbled back alley, a young woman with a long ponytail, in a black satin blouse and a burgundy leather skirt, stands at a heavy grey metal side door, smiling with a finger on her lips, while a young man in a dark jacket waits behind her. She slips back through the doorway, the man follows, and his hand pulls the door shut until it is closed. A black fire escape, bins, stacked crates and a round wall lamp line the alley, with pink neon light at its far end.

On a muddy country lane between a dry stone wall and a busy motorway, in low evening sun, a young man in a checked shirt, a quilted vest, jeans and rubber boots pushes hard against a huge round hay bale in the open gap of a wooden gate, blocking it. A long line of black and brown cattle comes trotting down the lane towards him and past him, and a young woman standing on the step of a tractor waves her arms. His cap lies in the mud.

On a wooden harbour pier at night under a full moon, a young woman in a black sleeveless bodysuit, dripping wet, walks forward holding up an open iron shackle on a long chain and shouting in triumph, her breath steaming. A heap of chains, a black box and an orange rope lie on the boards behind her. Friends cheer and hug, a man in a top hat and waistcoat points at her, and a young woman in a red jacket holds up a foil blanket, under strings of lights and an old street lamp.

On a narrow cobbled street of grey stone houses in the morning, a young man in a navy bathrobe and slippers stands in the open doorway of his house holding a steaming mug, looking shocked. A shaggy brown long-horned cow stands right beside him and snorts out a cloud of breath, and he steps back inside behind the glossy red front door with its brass knocker and fan-shaped window. A cat walks past two milk bottles on the step, a herd of cows fills the street behind, and a neighbour laughs at a window.

A flooded narrow street of old tall houses. A young woman with curly hair in a yellow raincoat, a sparkly silver dress and black boots stands in knee-deep water and forces a long iron crowbar into the gap of a blue wooden bakery door. The door bursts open with a splash and splinters, and she lowers the crowbar and laughs. A ginger cat sits on the brass door knocker above her, a loaf and a croissant float in the water, the shop window is full of bread, and two men carry a ladder behind.

In a bank vault in a basement corridor lit by harsh white and red light, a man in a black uniform shirt and trousers braces his legs and pushes a huge round steel vault door shut, gripping its spoked wheel handle with both hands. At first metal shelves inside hold a sparkling diamond and small boxes, then the heavy door swings closed over them. Security guards in dark uniforms stand at the end of the corridor at first, next to a steel trolley at the foot of a staircase.

An open front door at night on a wet street with rain falling. A soaked young woman with wet black hair, a navy raincoat and bare feet stands on the chequered tiled doorstep, smiling, holding a small ginger kitten against her chest. From inside the hallway someone in a white jumper throws a big yellow towel over her head and shoulders, and she steps inside wrapped in it, still holding the kitten and smiling. A yellow raincoat hangs on a hook and a lantern glows above the door.

An empty hallway with bare wooden floorboards, looking out through a wide open blue front door. A smiling young man in a white T-shirt carries a laughing young woman in a red top and denim dungarees in his arms and steps over the doorway into the house, while she raises one hand high in the air and a pigeon flies past. Inside, they stop and smile at each other. Cardboard moving boxes stand outside, a lemon tree in a pot stands by the door and a pink magnolia blooms.
